metadata.title: Ultimate BML Munjal University Food Walk l Lavish Hostel Mess Meal l Campus Food, Life and Culture
metadata.description:
College food memories are special because our choice of food revolves around many parameters like our company, taste, affordability, nutrition value and its filling nature. Taking our campus food series forward, we have come to BML Munjal University, a premiere institute run by Hero Group, to explore the myriad food options available across their campus and the experience was truly impressive. Hope you enjoy this mouthwatering tour with some lovely students and professors that features mess food to late night food joints.
